result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, business-hours auditing by an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, Vendor-funded costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct or remote systems access. It preserves the audit right and related payment obligations. However, the off-site-where-practicable and disruption-minimization requirements go beyond the stated playbook, and the systems-access prohibition unnecessarily duplicates section 22.2, so the redline is not strictly minimal.
